name: Nuclear Science and Engineering
description: Basics of nuclear physics, nuclear binding energy and stability, liquid drop model, shell model. Interaction of nuclear radiation with matter and nuclear detection engineering. Nuclear reaction, model, fission, fusion, nuclear reactors and their applications. Radioactivity, decay law, radioactive dating method, accelerator mass spectrometry. Nuclear reaction analysis, radioisotope production and applications in nuclear imaging process in biology.
